primary_question: Does assay-intrinsic synthetic sequence response explain BID-vs-ELAP reported-map discordance in human cells?

ELAP_response.notes: Axis orientation chosen by the paper's independently reported +1U preference; no human outcome used.

BACS_calibration_role: secondary resource; not required to declare Aim1A primary result
normalization: within-assay percentile; raw assay units are never subtracted
human_universe: union of sites reported by BID or ELAP, restricted to locally single-U exact loci

labels.shared: held out from fitting; continuum check only

inference.primary_discrimination: AUC of fixed synthetic calibration contrast
inference.effect: logistic OR per 0.1 contrast with motif-cluster-robust SE
inference.cross_context: HEK293T and HeLa analyzed independently; pooled interaction tests heterogeneity

not_done: no missing call interpreted as biological negative
